mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_student (student_id, student_name, birth, gender, school, address, address_detail, app_id, app_password, created_at, center_code, grade_key, status_key, student_privacy_agree) values (#{studentId}, #{studentName}, #{birth}, #{gender}, #{school}, #{address}, #{addressDetail}, #{appId}, #{appPassword}, SYSDATETIME(), #{centerCode}, #{gradeKey}, #{statusKey}, #{studentPrivacyAgree});
mapper.select: SELECT MAX(CAST(RIGHT (app_id, 1) AS INT)) AS maxSuffix FROM erp_student WHERE app_id LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix}, '%')

SELECT s.*, g.*, reg.registeredClassTypes as classType FROM erp_student s JOIN erp_grade_code g ON s.grade_key = g.grade_key OUTER APPLY ( SELECT STUFF(( SELECT ',' + cc.class_type FROM erp_time_table_assign ta JOIN erp_time_table t ON ta.time_table_key = t.time_table_key JOIN erp_class_code cc ON t.class_key = cc.class_key WHERE ta.student_id = s.student_id AND t.yy = #{year} AND t.mm = #{month} FOR XML PATH ('') , TYPE ).value('.' , 'NVARCHAR(MAX)') , 1 , 1 , '') AS registeredClassTypes) reg WHERE s.center_code = #{centerCode} AND ( reg.registeredClassTypes IS NULL OR reg.registeredClassTypes IN ('1' , '2') ) AND s.status_key = 'ACTIVE';

SELECT s.student_id AS studentId, s.student_name AS studentName, s.status_key AS statusKey, sc.status_name AS statusName, hc.class_name AS hanClass, bc.class_name AS bookClass, p.parent_tel_first + p.parent_tel_middle + p.parent_tel_last AS parentPhone, p.relation_key AS parentRelation, s.school AS school, s.grade_key AS gradeKey, gc.grade_name AS gradeName, s.gender AS genderKey, s.birth AS birth, s.address AS address, s.address_detail AS addressDetail from erp_student s JOIN erp_status_code sc ON s.status_key = sc.status_key JOIN erp_grade_code gc ON s.grade_key = gc.grade_key LEFT JOIN erp_teacher_assign ta ON s.student_id = ta.student_id LEFT JOIN erp_class_code hc ON ta.assign_han_class = hc.class_key LEFT JOIN erp_class_code bc ON ta.assign_book_class = bc.class_key JOIN erp_parent p ON s.student_id = p.student_id WHERE s.student_id = #{studentId}

SELECT s.student_id AS studentId, s.student_name AS studentName, sc.status_name AS statusName, FORMAT(s.created_at, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS entryDate, g.grade_name AS gradeName, s.school AS school, c.center_name AS centerName,
STUFF(( SELECT DISTINCT ', ' + cc2.class_name FROM erp_time_table_assign ta2 JOIN erp_time_table t2 ON t2.time_table_key = ta2.time_table_key LEFT JOIN erp_class_code cc2 ON cc2.class_key = CASE WHEN t2.class_key = 'COM' THEN ta2.class_key ELSE t2.class_key END WHERE ta2.student_id = s.student_id AND cc2.class_type = 1 AND t2.yy = FORMAT(GETDATE(),'yyyy') AND t2.mm = FORMAT(GETDATE(),'MM')
AND t2.user_code = #{userCode}
FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE ).value('.', 'nvarchar(max)'), 1, 2, '') AS hanClass,
STUFF(( SELECT DISTINCT ', ' + cc2.class_name FROM erp_time_table_assign ta2 JOIN erp_time_table t2 ON t2.time_table_key = ta2.time_table_key JOIN erp_class_code cc2 ON cc2.class_key = t2.class_key WHERE ta2.student_id = s.student_id AND cc2.class_type = 2 AND t2.yy = FORMAT(GETDATE(),'yyyy') AND t2.mm = FORMAT(GETDATE(),'MM')
AND t2.user_code = #{userCode}
FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE ).value('.', 'nvarchar(max)'), 1, 2, '') AS bookClass
FROM ERP_STUDENT s LEFT JOIN ERP_status_code sc ON sc.status_key = s.status_key LEFT JOIN ERP_grade_code g ON g.grade_key = s.grade_key LEFT JOIN ERP_center c ON c.center_code = s.center_code
WHERE 1 = 1 AND s.center_code = #{centerCode}
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM erp_time_table_assign ta JOIN erp_time_table t ON t.time_table_key = ta.time_table_key WHERE ta.student_id = s.student_id AND t.user_code = #{userCode} )
ORDER BY s.id

SELECT s.id AS id, s.student_id AS studentId, s.student_name AS studentName, sc.status_name AS statusName, FORMAT(s.created_at, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS entryDate, g.grade_name AS gradeName, s.school AS school, c.center_name AS centerName,
STUFF(( SELECT DISTINCT ', ' + cc2.class_name FROM erp_time_table_assign ta2 JOIN erp_time_table t2 ON t2.time_table_key = ta2.time_table_key LEFT JOIN erp_class_code cc2 ON cc2.class_key = CASE WHEN t2.class_key = 'COM' THEN ta2.class_key ELSE t2.class_key END WHERE ta2.student_id = s.student_id AND cc2.class_type = 1 AND t2.yy = FORMAT(GETDATE(),'yyyy') AND t2.mm = FORMAT(GETDATE(),'MM')
AND t2.user_code = #{userCode}
FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE ).value('.', 'nvarchar(max)'), 1, 2, '') AS hanClass,
STUFF(( SELECT DISTINCT ', ' + cc.class_name FROM erp_time_table_assign ta JOIN erp_time_table t ON t.time_table_key = ta.time_table_key JOIN erp_class_code cc ON cc.class_key = t.class_key WHERE ta.student_id = s.student_id AND cc.class_type = 2 AND t.yy = FORMAT(GETDATE(),'yyyy') AND t.mm = FORMAT(GETDATE(),'MM')
AND t.user_code = #{userCode}
FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE ).value('.', 'nvarchar(max)'), 1, 2, '') AS bookClass
FROM ERP_STUDENT s LEFT JOIN ERP_status_code sc ON sc.status_key = s.status_key LEFT JOIN ERP_grade_code g ON g.grade_key = s.grade_key LEFT JOIN ERP_center c ON c.center_code = s.center_code
LEFT JOIN ERP_time_table_assign ta ON s.student_id = ta.student_id LEFT JOIN ERP_time_table t ON ta.time_table_key = t.time_table_key
t.time_table_key = #{timeTableKey}
ORDER BY s.id
SELECT s.student_id AS studentId, s.status_key AS statusKey, sc.status_name AS statusName FROM ERP_STUDENT s JOIN ERP_STATUS_CODE sc on s.status_key = sc.status_key WHERE s.student_id = #{studentId}
mapper.update: UPDATE erp_student SET student_name = #{studentName}, birth = #{birth}, school = #{school}, address = #{address}, address_detail = #{addressDetail}, grade_key = #{gradeKey}, gender = #{genderKey}, updated_at = SYSDATETIME() where student_id = #{studentId}
UPDATE erp_parent SET parent_tel_first = #{first}, parent_tel_middle = #{middle}, parent_tel_last = #{last}, relation_key = #{relationKey}, updated_at = SYSDATETIME() where student_id = #{studentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ERP_TEACHER_ASSIGN (student_id, entry_han_date, entry_book_date, han_material_fee, book_material_fee, assign_han_teacher, assign_book_teacher) VALUES (#{student.studentId}, #{entryHanDate}, #{entryBookDate}, #{hanMaterialFee}, #{bookMaterialFee}, #{assignHanTeacher.userCode}, #{assignBookTeacher.userCode})
mapper.update:
UPDATE erp_student_class
han_class_key = #{hanClassCode.classKey}, han_user_code = #{hanUser.userCode}, han_fee = #{hanFee}, book_class_key = #{bookClassCode.classKey}, book_user_code = #{bookUser.userCode}, book_fee = #{bookFee},
updated_at = SYSDATETIME()
WHERE student_id = #{student.studentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_student_class (student_id, han_class_key, han_user_code, han_status, entry_han_date, han_fee, book_class_key, book_user_code, book_status, entry_book_date, book_fee, yy, mm, created_at) VALUES (#{student.studentId}, #{hanClassCode.classKey}, #{hanUser.userCode}, #{hanStatus}, #{entryHanDate}, #{hanFee}, #{bookClassCode.classKey}, #{bookUser.userCode}, #{bookStatus}, #{entryBookDate}, #{bookFee}, #{yy}, #{mm}, SYSDATETIME())
mapper.select: SELECT s.student_id, s.student_name, g.grade_name, hc.class_name AS hanClass, bc.class_name AS bookClass, hu.user_name AS hanTeacher, bu.user_name AS bookTeacher, (SELECT MAX(sth.move_at) FROM erp_student_transfer_history sth WHERE sth.student_id = s.student_id) AS moveAt, s.created_at FROM erp_student s JOIN erp_grade_code g ON s.grade_key = g.grade_key JOIN erp_student_class stuc ON s.student_id = stuc.student_id LEFT JOIN erp_class_code hc ON stuc.han_class_key = hc.class_key LEFT JOIN erp_class_code bc ON stuc.book_class_key = bc.class_key LEFT JOIN erp_user hu ON stuc.han_user_code = hu.user_code LEFT JOIN erp_user bu ON stuc.book_user_code = bu.user_code WHERE s.center_code = #{centerCode} AND stuc.yy = #{yy} AND stuc.mm = #{mm}

choose.when: UPDATE erp_student_class SET han_user_code = #{userCode}, han_fee = 0, han_material_fee = 0, han_class_key = NULL WHERE student_id = #{studentId}
UPDATE erp_student_class SET book_user_code = #{userCode}, book_fee = 0, book_material_fee = 0, book_class_key = NULL WHERE student_id = #{studentId}

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_student_transfer_history (student_id, from_user_code, to_user_code, class_type, transfer_reason, class_key, move_at, created_at) VALUES (#{student.studentId}, #{fromUser.userCode}, #{toUser.userCode}, #{classType}, #{transferReason}, #{classCode.classKey}, #{moveAt}, SYSDATETIME());
mapper.select: SELECT center_code as centerCode, student_id as stuid, student_name as name, app_token as token FROM erp_student WHERE app_id = #{appId}
mapper.update: UPDATE erp_student_attendance SET in_time = #{inTime}, attendance_date = #{attendanceDate}, attendance_key = #{attendanceKey}, check_in_updated_at = SYSDATETIME() WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND week = #{week} AND in_time IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT in_time, out_time, attendance_date, student_id, attendance_key FROM erp_student_attendance WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND attendance_date = #{attendanceDate}

SELECT s.snapshot_ym AS snapshotYm, s.active_count, s.rest_count, s.withdrawn_count, s.wait_count,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM STUDENT_TRANSFER_HISTORY WHERE CONCAT(YEAR(move_at), '-', LPAD(MONTH(move_at), 2, '0')) = s.snapshot_ym) AS moveInCount,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM STUDENT_TRANSFER_HISTORY WHERE CONCAT(YEAR(move_at), '-', LPAD(MONTH(move_at), 2, '0')) = s.snapshot_ym) AS moveOutCount
FROM student_monthly_snapshot s WHERE s.snapshot_ym BETWEEN #{startYm} AND #{endYm} ORDER BY s.snapshot_ym

SELECT s.snapshot_ym AS snapshotYm, s.active_count, s.rest_count, s.withdrawn_count, s.wait_count,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM STUDENT_TRANSFER_HISTORY WHERE TO_USER_NO = #{userNo} AND CONCAT(YEAR(move_at), '-', LPAD(MONTH(move_at), 2, '0')) = s.snapshot_ym) AS moveInCount,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM STUDENT_TRANSFER_HISTORY WHERE FROM_USER_NO = #{userNo} AND CONCAT(YEAR(move_at), '-', LPAD(MONTH(move_at), 2, '0')) = s.snapshot_ym) AS moveOutCount
FROM student_monthly_snapshot s WHERE s.snapshot_ym BETWEEN #{startYm} AND #{endYm} ORDER BY s.snapshot_ym

SELECT s.student_id as studentId, s.student_name as studentName, s.app_password as password, c.center_code as centerCode, c.center_name as centerName, s.grade_key as gradeKey, s.app_id as appId, s.app_password as appPassword FROM ERP_STUDENT s JOIN erp_center c ON s.center_code = c.center_code WHERE s.app_id = #{appId}
